conviction_note: The company has beaten its own revenue guide by 12-14% for four quarters running, so Q4 probably lands near $5.8M against a $5.3M guide (print_vs_bar +9). But this stock's reactions to those beats, rebuilt from the real release dates, were -0.3%, -1.9% and +4.3%, and customer deposits at 31 March were down 82% year on year, which leans the Q1 FY27 guide soft. The two roughly cancel, so +0.2 is effectively an honest zero.
bar: Company guide: Q4 FY26 revenue of about $5.3M, gross margin 25-30% (Q3 FY26 release, 2026-05-14, https://www.newsfilecorp.com/release/297431/Moving-iMage-Technologies-Reports-Revenue-of-3.39M-for-Seasonally-Soft-Q3-Bolstered-by-DCS-Cinema-Loudspeaker-Shipments-Hosts-Call-Today-at-11am-ET). No sell-side estimates found. Nobody asked a question on the Q3 call (https://ca.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/earnings-call-transcript-moving-image-technologies-q3-2026-sees-improved-margins-93CH-4639132).
positioning_check: FINRA short interest was 56,828 shares at the 2026-08-31 settlement, 2.07 days to cover (https://equibles.com/stocks/mitq/short-interest, snippet_only). That is about 0.6% of the 9.94M shares outstanding, so the short is not crowded and a squeeze is not a mechanism here. There is no options market, so there is no skew. The 20-day run-up is +6.4%, carried almost entirely by an unexplained volume spike on 2026-09-14: 995,700 shares against a normal 3-30k, close +6.7%, intraday high $0.72 (Yahoo chart v8). Volume stayed at 200-470k a day through 09-21. I found no news, filing or 13D that explains it, so it is worth 0.

findings.finding: MITQ has beaten its own revenue guide by 12-14% in each of the last four quarters: Q4 FY25 $5.88M vs $5.2M, Q1 FY26 $5.58M vs $4.9M, Q2 $3.8M vs $3.4M, Q3 $3.39M vs $3.0M. The $5.3M Q4 FY26 guide was set six weeks into the quarter on two named exhibitor projects plus DCS, which implies a print near $5.8-6.0M.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Rebuilt from actual bmo release dates (Yahoo daily closes), close before to close of release day: Q1 FY26 (2025-11-14), a 14% beat, -0.3%. Q2 (2026-02-12), a 12% beat, -1.9%. Q3 (2026-05-14), a 13% beat plus a margin beat, +4.3%, then -5.6% the next day. Q4 FY25 (2025-09-26), a 13% beat, -25.4%, but that was the unwind of a spike from $0.75 to $1.52 in the three weeks before. Beats have bought roughly nothing.
findings.why_not_priced: If the market were holding the true bar of about $5.9M, the stock would have moved on the pattern already. Instead it has reacted near zero to four same-sized beats and trades at about 0.3x sales, and no analyst asked a question on the last call. Because the beat pattern is so regular, it is arguably the market's real bar, which is why the size is small.
findings.independence: Separate documents give each quarter's guide and actual: the Q1 FY26 guide of $4.9M is in the Q4 FY25 release (https://www.theglobeandmail.com/investing/markets/markets-news/Newsfile/35057288/moving-image-technologies-q4-net-loss-improved-to-156-000-vs-416-000-last-year-and-year-end-net-cash-rises-to-5-7m-hosts-call-today-at-11am-et/), the Q2 guide of $3.4M in the Q1 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1770236/000143774925035555/ex_889665.htm), and the Q3 guide of $3.0M in the Q2 release (https://finance.yahoo.com/news/moving-image-technologies-achieves-q2-124700815.html). As background only, not transmission: the April-June 2026 domestic box office was the best quarter since 2019 (https://gower.st/articles/keeping-momentum-2026-sees-highest-grossing-june-quarter-first-half-this-decade-international-domestic-box-office/).

findings.finding: Customer deposits were $270k at 31 March 2026, against $1,534k at 31 March 2025 and $1,101k at 30 June 2025, down 82% year on year. The deposit-backed project pipeline going into FY27 is thin, and Q1 FY26 ($5.58M, lifted by a one-time custom cinema project) is a hard comp for the Q1 FY27 guide this release will carry.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The company guides one quarter ahead every release. Last September it guided Q1 FY26 to $4.9M, below the prior-year $5.3M, and the stock fell 25.4% that day, though that move is confounded by a spike unwind. At Q1 and Q2 the guides were below the prior-year actuals and the reactions were -0.3% and -1.9%.
findings.why_not_priced: The deposit line sits in a 10-Q contract-liability note that no aggregator carries, on a name with no coverage. If it were priced, the stock would already have de-rated after 2026-05-14. Instead it has held $0.59-0.66 since. Caveats reflected in the size: some of the fall may be mix, with DCS product sales paid on delivery rather than by deposit, and this company habitually guides about 13% below what it delivers, so a soft headline guide is the norm.
findings.independence: The comp comes from a different document: the Q1 FY26 release attributes the $5.6M to 'delivery of a custom cinema project' (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1770236/000143774925035555/ex_889665.htm). The deposit trend is also consistent with the 2025-05 10-Q's $1,534k (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1770236/000177023625000021/mitq-20250331x10q.htm). Against it, from a different source: Cinemark reported a record Q2 2026 with record premium-format sales (https://ir.cinemark.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/646/cinemark-celebrates-record-breaking-q2-2026-results). That is a macro read-through, a hypothesis only, and it is one reason the size is small.

outside_window.finding: The FY26 10-K is due around 2026-09-28. It is the first annual close under a CFO appointed 2026-04-27, and the company carries long-standing material weaknesses in its financial close. An NT 10-K or a late filing would be seen only after the exit.

searched_and_found_nothing: Three Form 4s filed 2026-09-22 (Stiska, Crothall, Anderson) are late catch-up filings of routine director stock grants going back to 2023, code A at $0. No open-market buying or selling. https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1770236/000143774926030985/xslF345X06/rdgdoc.xml
The 2026-09-14 volume spike (about 1M shares, 30-100x normal): no press release, 8-K, 13D/13G or news found. Unexplained, so worth 0.
Company newsflow between 2026-05-14 and 2026-09-17: no press releases at all (https://www.stocktitan.net/news/MITQ/).

Listing risk: no NYSE American deficiency notice, reverse-split proposal or share-authorisation increase. The April 2026 annual meeting voted only on directors and the auditor (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1770236/000143774926011983/mitq20260408_8k.htm).
Financing: no debt, no ATM, no S-3. Cash fell $5.7M to $2.4M, mostly on the $1.5M DCS asset purchase, which had no earn-out. The 10-Q has no going-concern language.
Customer concentration: no customer was above 10% in Q3, so no single-counterparty read-through is available.
baseline_tension: No skew and no crowded short. The +6.4% 20-day run-up rests on an unexplained 09-14 volume spike and has partly faded. Nothing I found cuts strongly against the price, and a stock that has ignored four same-sized beats makes 'already priced' the most likely reading.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (the reaction function vetoes the fundamental read): cut the guide-beat finding from +1.0 to +0.8, because the rebuilt history shows three same-sized beats bought -0.3, -1.9 and +4.3. print_vs_bar stays at +9.

Rule 3 (the caveat has to reach the number): cut the deposit-decline finding from -0.8 to -0.6. Its own text concedes DCS mix and the habitual conservative guide, and the only offset (a record Cinemark premium quarter) is macro transmission (rule 5).
Rule 5: the unexplained 09-14 volume spike and the strong box office stay at 0, as context only.

Rule 6: the bar is the company's own guide, so no cap was needed. The 10-K/NT risk was moved to outside_window. Rule 7: short interest was checked and is not crowded, so the negative was not shrunk further.
The lesson on untrustworthy baseline history was applied: the base rate was rebuilt from confirmed release dates instead of the baseline's 8-K dates.
Rule 8 was considered and did not change anything: the beat is a pattern, not a confirmed pre-determined number, and this name's own distribution of reactions to beats is damped.
